test_name: Verify 'Expand all' and 'Collapse all' functionality for API endpoint details
description: This test ensures a user can expand and collapse all API endpoint details using the respective buttons.
steps: Verify that all API endpoint details are expanded.
Verify that all API endpoint details are collapsed.
expected_results: All API endpoint details expand when 'Expand all' is clicked.
All API endpoint details collapse when 'Collapse all' is clicked.
edge_cases: The 'Expand all' button is not visible or clickable.
The 'Collapse all' button is not visible or clickable.
Only some API endpoint details expand or collapse.
Buttons are unresponsive due to JavaScript errors.
Expanded details are unreadable or improperly formatted.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the API documentation page.
API endpoint details must be available and expandable.
dependencies: JavaScript is functional for the buttons.
performance_metrics: Time taken to expand or collapse all details.
Responsiveness of the buttons under load.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure buttons are accessible via keyboard navigation.
Check for proper ARIA roles for 'Expand all' and 'Collapse all' buttons.
Verify sufficient color contrast for the buttons.
